=={{header|Cxc}}==

No synchronous recursion in the language, so factorial becomes a tail-call loop: the accumulator threads through self-send until n reaches 1.

<syntaxhighlight lang="elixir">
def main:
    use console: Console
    -> running
        self :> step(10, 1)

    running <: step(n: Int, acc: Int):
        |:  n <= 1 -> end
            console.write(acc.to_string())
        |?: -> running
            self :> step(n - 1, acc * n)
</syntaxhighlight>
